second_order: fooling and getting fooled with fake music posts
theme_note: Fake releases, polls and interviews invite belief; replies reveal, resent, praise, reuse, and grow wary of the bait.

second_order: getting the ITAOTS drawing started with recruits, guides, and Discord
theme_note: Participants propose the cover, recruit by comparison, choose a start, move live talk to Discord, report progress, and make a colour guide.

second_order: relocating and restarting ITAOTS when sites and tools fail
theme_note: Interference, occupied space, risky neighbours, broken references, and scattered work prompt reporting, new coordinates, pin requests, troubleshooting, and consolidation.

second_order: arguing whether loose weekend posting welcomes people or makes the sub look bad
theme_note: Members contrast a disorganised front page with fun, accessible question threads and propose compromises without showing an adopted rule.

second_order: turning Music by Men into parody and a real argument
theme_note: A gender-reversal joke is recognised and extended, while the same exchange becomes a sustained disagreement over women-focused discussion and equality.

second_order: mocking what counts as indie with wrong names and local lore
theme_note: Participants caricature taste, status and independence, deliberately rename artists, and recover old room-specific jokes and their sources.

second_order: calling members to struggle after /mu/ ‘seized’ the Discord
theme_note: The title makes a single unanswered call; the record does not settle whether members treated it as a joke, takeover, or invitation.

second_order: dividing up the ITAOTS build and getting it done
theme_note: A consolidated spot and sticky lead members to name parts, take the water, dress, arms and borders, and coordinate toward completion.

second_order: bargaining with neighbours and returning pixel help
theme_note: Participants fit drawings together, negotiate peace and borders, seek moderator counterparts, accept relocation help, promise repairs, and reciprocate assistance.

second_order: building the TVU&N banana through corrections and handoffs
theme_note: The next cover moves from planning to coordinates, refreshing, template discipline, completion, and overnight regional handoffs.

second_order: celebrating and explaining the album covers they got onto the canvas
theme_note: Success calls, thanks, pride, screenshots, and explanations make the finished covers into a shared accomplishment for members and outsiders.

second_order: defending and repairing the album covers and nearby canvas
theme_note: Members rally defence, refresh and follow templates, hand off watch, restore damage, and answer threats to their work and adjacent pieces.

second_order: testing which album or logo to draw next
theme_note: Members float images, ask for support, compare templates and pixel feasibility, poll preferences, reject difficult designs, and sometimes never reach placement.

second_order: mourning the end and remembering frantic, absorbing work
theme_note: After placement closes, participants mourn, feel freed, recount attacks and frantic repairs, and differ between pride, fun, absorption and relief.

second_order: learning that the canvas was already over
theme_note: A late album-cover proposal receives a direct correction that r/place has ended, followed by acknowledgement and sadness rather than renewed organising.
